original_test_intent: Verify installed processors boot and expose the approved physical sockets, cores per socket, threads per core, total logical CPUs and online/offline state in BIOS and required OSes.
original_method: Qualified operator installs CPUs/cooling and captures BIOS/Windows recognition; after stable Linux boot, agent securely captures full lscpu, nproc, /proc and sysfs online/topology evidence; engineer reconciles physical and logical counts with the specification.
manual_activity: Operator installs CPUs/cooling and records BIOS/Windows; agent may securely collect Linux topology after boot.
required_inputs: Expected sockets, physical cores/socket, threads/core, total logical and online/offline counts
SMT, virtualization, CPU-disable and firmware policy
Required Windows/BIOS coverage plus secure Linux access/tools
safety_requirements: No BIOS SMT/CPU disable/virtualization/power change without approval
Stop on missing/offline unexpected CPUs, thermal/SEL/boot error or contradiction
No automatic reboot, setting change or recovery
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw lscpu, nproc, /proc and sysfs online/topology after approval
Calculate and compare physical/logical counts with supplied spec
Do not install hardware, attest BIOS/Windows, change CPU state or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Ensure qualified install and BIOS/Windows evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally relevant but unsafe SSH is rejected; `nproc` is online processing units, not physical cores, and grep can omit CPU lists/context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely preserve full `lscpu`, `nproc`, `/proc/cpuinfo`, `/sys/devices/system/cpu/online` and per-CPU topology files.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Core number, Windows/Linux manual setup and5/0 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use field-by-field sockets×cores×threads math plus online/offline CPU lists and BIOS/Windows evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure raw evidence, SMT/virtualization context, online-state checks and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: nproc alone cannot distinguish physical cores, SMT threads or offline CPUs.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware CPU disablement, SMT, virtualization and hotplug/offline state affect reported totals.

project_override_considerations: Project may allow disabled cores or SMT settings only with explicit expected matrix; no topology is inferred.
expected_evidence: Raw lscpu/nproc/proc/sysfs topology and online lists
Thermal, dmesg/syslog/SEL and stable final state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria consistently cover CPU core/topology recognition. Missing numeric topology is a project readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator/hardware/spec/tools can be supplied; hybrid manual setup and automated read-only inventory is feasible.

review_improvement: Distinguishes physical cores from online logical CPUs and adds secure, complete topology evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: `nproc` counts processing units available to the process, which may exclude offline or affinity-limited CPUs and includes SMT threads. Physical core validation requires sockets, core IDs and threads/core plus online lists. BIOS/Windows evidence is also necessary because Linux enumeration alone cannot attest installation steps.
